name: SideStep Apps
_comment: SideStep's own curated list of legitimate, sideloadable iOS apps distributed as .ipa files. Published as a GitHub release asset (tag 'apps'); the URL above is always the latest. Icons are hosted alongside as release assets. To propose an app, send a pull request updating this file in johnbuckman/SideStep.

apps.name: Stay on Track
apps.localizedDescription: A fully-offline hiking companion that keeps you on your intended trail — a British voice calls out "Left / Right / Straight" as you approach every junction where another path joins, and speaks how far you have strayed if you wander off-trail. Pause for a break — it can also auto-pause when you stop moving — and your estimated time to the finish keeps using your real walking pace instead of counting your rest stops. An elevation profile shows the climbs and descents ahead, along with nearby restaurants and public toilets on the route (and the time you will reach each), plus offline OpenStreetMap maps that work in airplane mode. Requires iOS 17.

apps.name: Magnatune
apps.localizedDescription: The Magnatune music player — stream and download the full Magnatune catalog of independent, artist-friendly music. Not available on the App Store; installable by sideloading with your own Apple ID.

apps.name: iWish
apps.localizedDescription: iWish brings Tcl/Tk to iOS — a full scripting language and native GUI toolkit running on your iPhone or iPad. A developer/power-user environment Apple does not distribute on the App Store.

apps.name: Decaid
apps.localizedDescription: The open-source iOS controller app for the Decent Espresso machine (formerly “reaprime”). Sideload it directly with your own Apple ID.

apps.name: de1app
apps.localizedDescription: The original Decent Espresso machine controller app (de1app) for iPad, now sideloadable with your own Apple ID. Runs on Tcl/Tk via iWish; self-updates in place. Being gradually succeeded by Decaid.

apps.name: dcamp
apps.localizedDescription: The native app for the Decent Espresso community forum (“the Diaspora”). Read and post to the forums, chat and DM other owners, react to posts, get AI summaries of what’s new, and read every thread automatically translated into your language. A companion to de1app. Requires iOS 17.

apps.name: Decent Cocktails
apps.localizedDescription: Every cocktail from The PDT Cocktail Book and Death & Co: Modern Classic Cocktails, weighed to the gram and working offline. Browse by spirit, ingredient, glass and sweetness; resize a recipe for a round or a less boozy drink; and make it step by step on the Half Decent Scale over Bluetooth. Sign in with your decentespresso.com account for Your Bar, your Wishlist and the cocktails you’ve made, shared with the website. In English, German, French, Spanish, Korean, Arabic and Chinese. Requires iOS 17.

apps.name: Decent Timer
apps.localizedDescription: A simple kitchen timer that runs on older iPads (iOS 15+) that the App Store no longer supports — a good example of keeping an old device useful by sideloading.

apps.name: Decently Fluent
apps.localizedDescription: A graded reader. Pick a classic from Project Gutenberg, or open your own EPUB, PDF or text file, and read it rewritten at your level (A1 to C1, or Native) in English, French, German, Spanish or Italian, with your own language beside it when you turn the phone sideways. Where a published human translation exists it is used instead of machine translation. Tap a word for its meaning, double-tap words you don't know and the book brings them back until you've learned them. The most recommended books for French and German learners open ready to read, their first pages already written at A1, A2 and B1, and every recommended book comes with a short description. A research-based guide (Paul Nation's work on learning from reading) recommends books that fit your level. Only the next few pages are rewritten as you read, using your own Claude or DeepSeek API key. Requires iOS 17.
